parametrized_description: A rocket travels along a straight path with discrete-time dynamics: x_{t+1} = x_t + v_t and v_{t+1} = v_t + a_t. The rocket starts at position InitialPosition with velocity InitialVelocity and must reach position FinalPosition with velocity FinalVelocity at time TotalTime. The goal is to minimize the maximum thrust (maximum absolute acceleration) to reduce passenger discomfort.

FinalPosition.description: Target final position of the rocket

FinalVelocity.description: Target final velocity of the rocket

Position.description: Position of the rocket at time t

Velocity.description: Velocity of the rocket at time t

Acceleration.description: Acceleration (thrust) of the rocket at time t

MaxThrust.description: Maximum absolute acceleration across all time steps

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((Position[t+1] == Position[t] + Velocity[t] for t in range(TotalTime - 1)), name="PosDynamics")
model.addConstrs((Velocity[t+1] == Velocity[t] + Acceleration[t] for t in range(TotalTime - 1)), name="VelDynamics")

constraints.description: MaxThrust must be at least the absolute value of each acceleration.

code.gurobipy:
model.addConstrs((MaxThrust >= Acceleration[t] for t in range(TotalTime)), name="MaxThrustPos")
model.addConstrs((MaxThrust >= -Acceleration[t] for t in range(TotalTime)), name="MaxThrustNeg")

objective.description: Minimize the maximum thrust (absolute acceleration) over all time steps.
